articleTitle: Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Nowadays, cardiovascular diseases are one of those diseases that cause the most deaths globally. According to the report of the WHO, approximately 1 crore 79 lakh people lost their lives due to cardiovascular disease in the year 2019. This death represents almost 32% of all deaths that occurred globally. And, of the 32% of deaths, 85% were caused solely by heart attacks and strokes. The best way to avoid these premature deaths is to detect cardiovascular disease as soon as possible. This survey explains how machine learning and deep learning can aid in the early detection of cardiovascular disease, allowing us to avoid many premature deaths. Our model achieved a maximum accuracy of 83.33% with a mean squared error of 0.1667%.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence for Implementation of Business Model Innovation in an Industrial Company
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper emphasizes the business model innovations encompassing artificial intelligence. A business model transformation can be partially facilitated by this technology. Artificial intelligence in the context of business model innovations is the most comprehensive tool for cognitive thinking support. In this way, a number of studies have been included, some of which are indicated by the author in the report. Several relevant theoretical views are stated as well to mix AI, business model innovations, creativity, and road mapping conceptions. A model for the assessment of AI company readiness has been adopted in order to assess its current and expected score. A conceptual implication for the practical implementation of AI-supported methodology in an industrial company is also presented. The proposed methodological sequence, supported by the relevant methods and tools, provides opportunities for a formalization of the successful application of AI and creativity in business model innovations.

articleTitle: A New Type of Wind Generator Blades Mechanical Automatic Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Wind power in Kazakhstan, following the global trend, continues to develop and there is an increase in the number of RES power plants. The development of wind energy involves the creation of large-sized and high-power installations. The rotors of wind turbines experience heavy loads on their design. Thus, the actual task and problem for the wind energy park of Kazakhstan is to reduce the load on the structure by regulating it during wind gusts. The use of a control system for the rotation of the blades makes it possible to significantly reduce the load on the structure. However, due to the non- linearity of the process and the difficulty of accurately measuring the wind speed, the blade turning control system must be designed with great care. This paper presents the development of a lever mechanical system for controlling the blades of a wind turbine, which makes it possible to secure the operation of a wind generator. The purpose of the study is to develop a 3D model of a lever control system and create an automatic control system for it. A three-dimensional study of the rotor in various states of the rotor was carried out. This dynamic computer model is proof of the functionality of the communication system. The transfer function of the entire control system is also determined and, based on experimental data, a mathematical model of an experimental laboratory sample is developed. This installation will optimize the operation of a vertical axis wind generator by creating a wind flow control system for further converting the wind flow into electrical energy.

articleTitle: Pilot Based Stepped-Carrier OFDM to Retrieve High Resolution Range-Velocity Profile in Joint Vehicular Communication and Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a good candidate for joint radar sensing and vehicular communication convergence in the 77-81GHz band. Recent publications show the interest of using pilot based OFDM to ensure good detection skills while maintaining, at the same time, a good vehicular communication link. Nevertheless, OFDM is a wide band signal that requires ADC's with fast sampling rates which hinds its practical use in automotive and low-cost radars. To reduce the baseband bandwidth of the OFDM signal and still reaching a high-resolution range profile (HRR), Stepped-Carrier OFDM has been proposed and seems to be efficient for radar sensing skills. This paper presents a pilot based Stepped-Carrier OFDM processing that allows an efficient radar detection skill in a joint radar and communication system. Based on results obtained in the current paper, our work highlights benefit of a dynamic pilot allocation depending on the vehicular environment while reducing the needed sampling rate of the radar receiver.

articleTitle: On Thermal Image Classification with ANN and Similarity Based Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The objective of the work is to evaluate a set of classifiers based on similarity of patterns, in the context of human thermal images, and for face and emotion recognition. The processing and classification of such images is important for various difficult environments, i.e., media with less lightning, including here the actual pandemic context. The classifiers use various distances to evaluate the similarity among patterns. The classification objective is to recognize the person and the state, from a set of three values, i.e., normal, happy, and sad. Three solutions were considered. The first one uses an artificial neural net, in a standard multilayer feedforward structure. The second one uses the discrete cosine transform (DCT) for feature selection. The last one uses the entropy of the processed images for feature selection. A classifier based on minimum distance is used for the last two solutions. The best results are obtained with DCT based features. The methods could be extended to other types of images, as ultrasound or time-frequency based images.

articleTitle: Docker Container Performance Comparison on Windows and Linux Operating Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Docker virtualization technology is now widely used not just in Linux, but also in Windows. When working with containers, it's critical to understand how Docker's performance on Windows compares to Docker's performance on Linux. Is it reasonable to execute a Linux program in a Docker container on Windows? A test tool was created to evaluate Docker's performance on Linux and Windows. This software determines the speed at which simple arithmetic operations are performed, the speed at which RAM is used, and the speed at which read/write operations on a disk drive are performed. This software has been tested on both Linux and Windows operating systems using a Docker container. Docker's arithmetic and memory performance on Linux is marginally better than on Windows, according to testing. Significant performance reduction is found only when communicating with an NVMe SSD under Windows. Thus, in the majority of scenarios, running Docker on Windows makes sense and does not result in substantial performance reduction.

articleTitle: DC-DC Converter for Adaptation of Thin-Film PV Panel I-V Characteristics for Microinverter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: With increasing uncertainty in the supply of the main energy carriers (gas and oil), as well as the increasing cost of electricity on a European scale, the use of small photovoltaic systems (PV), is gaining more and more interest. The development of power electronic technologies would help the faster implementation of small PV systems in households and in places without an electricity grid. In the present work, the focus is placed on the modeling of a DC-DC converter for connecting a thin-film PV panel to a microinverter. The goal is to integrate such a converter to connect the panel to the microinverter seamlessly. The volt-ampere characteristic of the panel is transformed by the converter so that the PV module voltage matches the input voltage of the microinverter. A simulation model of the system involving thin-film PV panel, DC-DC converter and input stage of the microinverter with MPPT controller was developed in Matlab/Simulink environment. The obtained results show the adequacy of the approach and the flawless operation of the proposed DC-DC converter with a microinverter.

articleTitle: Modelling and Study of the Downlink Physical Layer in 5G NR Mobile Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Realistic evaluation of 5G NR performance require standard-compatible simulation models. This paper discusses the MATLAB 5G NR-based downlink physical layer simulation model. The basic architecture of the simulation model and the block architecture of the 5G NR transmitter and receiver models are described. The presented model is used in the performance analysis by estimating BER (Bit Error rate), BLER (Block Error Rate) and throughput under different conditions in the transmission channel. The results are presented and analysed when conducting the simulation with and without enabling the mechanisms of HARQ (Hybrid Automatic Repeat reQuest) and at different values of CQI (Channel Quality Indicator).

articleTitle: Investigation of Acceleration and Brake Deceleration of Light Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper describes a study aimed at determining the average value of the acceleration of a car starting from a standstill and reaching a certain speed. Also, the average value of negative acceleration during braking of a car starting its braking process from a different initial speed has been investigated and determined. The determination of these parameters is of particular importance, since their average value depends on the current speed of the car and in order to be able to accurately determine some dynamic parameters of the vehicle’s movement, it is necessary that these parameters are as close as possible to the actual ones.

articleTitle: Development of an Automated PLC System to Help Maintain the Internal Combustion Engine at a Constant Speed
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper advances a newly developed PLC system for motor speed stabilization performed on a dynamometric test bench. This allows the recording of various steady-state engine parameter characteristics, such as: torque, fuel consumption, etc. The system hereto proposed provides for stabilization of the revolutions pre-set by the operator, enables bench vizualisation of specific parameters and their scheduled recording at a specified period of time.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi and Computer Vision based Embedded System for the Implementation of Smart Street Lighting Controls
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This project presents the design and modeling of a smart street lighting system on a test bench by employing Open Source Computer Vision Library (OpenCV) and a Raspberry Pi 4 interfaced with a camera module. The camera module connected to the Raspberry Pi continuously monitors the road. The OpenCV-based algorithm, on detecting the approaching vehicle, calculates the speed of the car in real-time, based on which, it then estimates the number of lights to be switched on. The algorithm was tested in various scenarios with varying levels of light intensity and background. The system detected the vehicles with high accuracy and controlled lighting accordingly.

articleTitle: Application of a Gravitational-Benchmark Model for Road-Transport Energy Evaluation: Simulation Results
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: A systematic approach has been composed for studying the possibilities for application of an existing criterion model for informative assessment of the energy efficiency of transportation processes. Based on the proposed methodology and on six selected typical objects in the field, extensive simulation studies have been performed based on the average fuel consumption of motor vehicles. New data have been obtained for efficiency coefficient of transport processes, as the efficiency coefficient varies within the intervals (0.004… 59.7) %, (0.001…14.92) % and (0.001…3.89) % for the objects of classification groups A1, A2 and B, respectively. The performed research is the first step of the justification of the workability and the practical applicability of the criterion model.

articleTitle: Effect of Drum Ball Mill Lining Shape on Specific Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: About 30% of the energy used in the extraction, transport, and processing of mineral raw materials falls on the milling process carried out by drum mills. The mills operating on the territory of Bulgaria are driven by electric motors with power from 1000 to 10,000kW. The aspiration is through management to achieve production quality with low energy consumption. For milling process efficiency, the objective function is low specific energy consumption (SpEC). The different shape and mass of the linings lead to a difference in the productivity and, accordingly power and specific energy consumption of the mills. In the present work, an analytical study of the influence of the shape of three types of linings on the SpEC of a drum ball mill (DBM) type МTP 4.5Х6 milling copper ores has been carried out. Profiles of the lifters are selected: straight ribs, herringbone, and wavy. The obtained results are shown in graphic form, and for this purpose, according to a developed algorithm, the data were entered into electronic tables for automatic calculation of SpEC during gradual wear of the mill linings. On the basis of the obtained results, the relevant conclusions were written. With the lowest SpEC and high productivity is a wavy profile.

articleTitle: A Study of ZigBee Networks in Experimental Environment and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The ability to actively monitor various everyday objects provided by the Internet of Things (IoT) technologies is increasing the popularity of these networks and leading to their growth. This scale of usage requires the provision of high Quality of Service (QoS) for end-users. In this paper is represented a study of the End_to_End Delay, Throughput and Packet Loss Ratio parameters in a real ZigBee network with end nodes from manufacturers Texas Instruments and Sonoff, and the author’s simulation of the ZigBee network in ideal environment. A comparison between the obtained results presented, on basis of which recommendations formulated for the selection of devices for the construction of a ZigBee network, according to the specific QoS requirements in the network, as well as determining the application possibilities of the simulation product under consideration.

articleTitle: A New Data Structure for Digital Optimization of the Educational Profile of the State Universities in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This study generated a program for digital optimization of the educational profile of public higher education institutions in Bulgaria, a software program that allows the process of data sets, sorting and comparing data, and combining data according to specific criteria to add and remove visual elements. By connecting the optimization logic, an effective model of a particular object - a university - is achieved. The logic of the program is driven by graphic elements that can be accessed through the JavaFX library. Using the software program, generated in the current development, determines the optimal profile of each of the higher schools included in it according to the criteria for atypical and unprofitable majors. During development, the optimal profile of each university is combined with the option of merging some higher education institutions into mega structures. As a result, it has been proven that reducing the state subsidy for economically unprofitable and atypical majors for a given university is a better option for higher education reform than consolidation reform. At the same time, the program offers an optimization model that leads to a lower social and financial cost of reforming higher education.

articleTitle: Guidelines of Effective Thermal Modeling of an Outer Rotor PM Machine with Concentrated Windings
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this paper the guideline for choosing right thermal equations of a thermal network of PM machines is given. In this paper, a thermal model (TM) of the permanent magnet (PM) machine that combines two methods: a lumped parameter and empirical coefficients, is proposed. The suggested methodology for calculating resistances and capacitances bases on the fundamental material information so that the principle can be extended to make TM of the PM machines in industry. A concept for combining automated electromagnetic time-stepping finite element model and a circuit TM into a single program for the optimal design considering temperature constraints is presented. A FEM thermal model with the same boundary conditions of the circuit TM is developed to verify thermal network. The simulation and measured temperature in the steady state shows good agreement.

articleTitle: A Task-related Adaptation in Intelligent Human-Machine Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: We present a task-related adaptation method based on the interaction trinity paradigm, which consists of task-related, human state-of-mind-related, and context-related adaptation, set in the concept of intelligent Human-Machine Interface framework (iHMIfr). The method is implemented in a software application, developed with an inbuilt application manager, containing the task logic and real-time user performance monitoring. The user-specific task adaptation is based on monitoring the user’s performance variability and the application of predefined adaptive strategies.

articleTitle: Active Sitting as a Factor for Increasing Concentration During Computer Activities
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Prolonged work at a computer affects the health and quality of life of employees, as well as their productivity. More and more attention is being paid to the working posture during the performance of their usual activities as a factor to preserve their working capacity. The aim of this paper is to investigate the influence of a specific way of sitting - active sitting, on the degree of concentration of persons working at a computer. An experiment was conducted in which 97 participants took a selected tool (Stroop test) twice – using their usual working posture, positioned on an office chair, and creating conditions for active sitting with the help of a stability disc used as an air cushion. The results showed a statistically significant increase in success in solving the test and a decrease in reaction time in the active sitting mode of the participants.

articleTitle: Modeling of Photovoltaic-Wind Hybrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This article proposes a model for photovoltaic-wind hybrid systems. The system under investigation comprises five PV modules attached to the blades of a vertical-axis wind turbine. The solar irradiation readings at each PV module are monitored at three different tilt angles: 90°(default), 50°<sup>,</sup> and 10°. These measurements are taken on many selected days at random times around noon. This paper calculates the solar irradiation received at each PV module and estimates the optimum tilt angle of the system. A simple clear sky model is used for the calculation, the input data of the model is the solar geometry, including location latitude, solar azimuth angle and solar elevation angle, no aerosol or atmospheric data is necessary. A comparison between measurement and calculated data is conducted, and the result shows that the optimum tilt angle is 50°. The mean absolute percentage error is computed between the measured and calculated values and shows that it ranges between 11% and 17% at a 90° tilt angle, and between 5% and 17.4% at a 50° tilt angle.

articleTitle: Investigation of Diesel Engine with Hydrogen Additions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this paper, the diesel engine with hydrogen additions are investigated. The influence of hydrogen additives on the power, environmental and economic characteristics of a diesel engine has been studied. The study was carried out using a one-dimensional diesel engine model with the possibility of supplying hydrogen to the engine’s intake port The model was developed using the AVL Boost software.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Detecting the Location and Parameters of the Iris in the Human Eye
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In the present article, an algorithm for detecting iris in the human eye is proposed. The realization consists of two parts - opening the inner and outer edge of the iris. The Canny edge detection method is used to detect the inner edge, after which the result is filtered and smoothed. The Daugman algorithm has been modified to detect the outer edge of the iris. The results achieved are better interception and localization of the two circles of the iris. The software product used for image processing and implementation of algorithms is MATLAB.

articleTitle: Development of an Automated PLC System to Help Maintain the Water Brake Torque Constant Conducted on a Dynamometric Bench
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper advances a newly developed PLC system for water brake torque stabilization conducted on a dynamometric test bench. This allows the recording of various engine parameters and characteristics, such as: torque, fuel consumption, exhaust gas composition, etc. The system hereto proposed provides for stabilization of the brake torque pre-set by the operator or modification of the torque in accordance with a determined test bench setpoint and visualization of specific parameters as well as storing the history of changes in the respective parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Wireless Communication Technologies Used in Livestock Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this paper is analyzed the application of wireless technologies in Internet of Things (IoT) livestock monitoring systems. Initially are initialized the most important factors of the wireless technologies and characteristics of the wireless sensor networks, which limit their application. Next, are reviewed numerous applications of LoRa, ZigBee, WiFi, BLE, GPRS/3G/4G as well as other communication technologies. Their main areas of application, commonly used data sources, as well as the acceptable frequency and data volume of the sensor readings are evaluated. The results of this study provide the necessary information for designing a wide range of IoT systems, used for monitoring of indoor and outdoor bread animals, of the parameters of their environment and of different technological processes in livestock farms.

articleTitle: Photonic Band Gap Structure Integration in Topology for the Design and Manufacture of Quasi-Yagi Antennas
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper presents an opportunity to integrate an innovative photonic band gap (PBG) structure (based on the metamaterials concept) into design topology and manufacture Quasi-Yagi antennas. The design aims to implement PBG structure directly into the antenna design. That allows a galvanic connection between the antenna and metamaterial to improve Quasi-Yagi characteristics. Various simulations and measurements have been made showing the synthesized antenna system functionality and its applicability for different practical applications in communication systems - due to the operating frequency 2.4GHz.

articleTitle: Cyber-Physical System for Recognizing Dangerous Objects and Hazardous Substances with Smart Glasses
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: this paper aims to present a prototype of a cyber - physical system with smart glasses and specialized software that identifies dangerous objects carried by humans, possible dangerous substances, and others. The developed software meets the hardware and software requirements of smart glasses. The simplified user interface makes it easy for people to use the system, regardless of their technical skills.

articleTitle: Numerical Modelling of an Air Turbine for a Hybrid System for Sea Wave Energy Utilization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In connection with global warming and the depletion of energy production resources, new clean ways of obtaining energy are increasingly being sought. A source of renewable energy harvesting is the energy of sea and ocean waves. The present paper reports the design and modelling of an air turbine and its numerical simulation, which will be used in a hybrid system for utilization of the energy of wind waves.

articleTitle: Study of Latency for a Teleoperation System with Video Feedback using Wi-Fi and 4G-LTE Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this study was developed a teleoperable robotic arm with the aim of testing and analysing the teleoperation latency for three different communication channels. A closed-loop control (direct teleoperation) was adopted, with bidirectional communication, the operator receiving the necessary information for the teleoperation process in real-time from a video camera mounted on the robotic arm. In order to connect the control device with the teleoperable robotic arm were used three different communication channels and the latency of the teleoperation process was measured and analyzed for each of these three communication channels. This paper contains information about the mechanical, hardware and software parts of the developed robotic system. It also presents the communication channels that were tested and the results obtained. The aim is to identify the advantages and disadvantages of each of these three communication channels, to detect the limitations and to ascertain to what extent the teleoperation of such a system can be done efficiently.

articleTitle: Application of Wide Bandgap Transistors in Inverter Circuits to Replace Lamp Generators for Induction Heating
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The replacement of tube generators at high frequencies became possible with the advent of wideband semiconductors. The application of SiC and GaN in a resonant inverter for induction technologies with an operating frequency of 440kHz and a power of 10 kW is discussed. Theoretical and simulation studies proving the performance of the inverter circuits and comparative analysis in relation to their losses and efficiency are made.

articleTitle: Novel Blockchain - Based Models for Healthcare and Life Science Solution
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The health policy related to vaccination against infectious diseases of each country aims to limit epidemics and to preserve the health and workability of citizens, to prolong and to improve their lives. The coverage of the entire population with vaccination is one of the key factors in achieving these goals. This paper proposes several models, based on blockchain technologies, that ensure vaccination of the entire population, ignore the possibility of duplication and falsification of information, minimize paperwork between institutions involved in the vaccination process, improve the process of planning the necessary vaccines and more. The models are implemented on a private blockchain Hyperledger Fabric.

articleTitle: A Role of Technology Audit for Industrial Organizations with High Degree of Automation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Advanced product innovations that depend on technological processes in industrial production systems provide for the competitiveness of the manufacturing companies. The technological processes should be continuously improved in order efficiency to be ensured in the industrial production systems. Technology audit is periodic assessment of the correspondence to the recent technological processes of domain area and the perspectives for progress. The goal of the paper is to outline the role of technology audit in industrial organization with a high level of automation in order to ensure high productivity.

articleTitle: Discrimination between Broken Bars Fault and Load Torque Variation in Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents the discrimination between broken bars faults and load torque variation. The rotor bars fault and the load torque variation generate harmonics that appear at the same frequencies in the stator current spectrum. Therefore, it is almost impossible to distinguish between them. The proposed technique uses the stator current spectral analysis, but based on the monitoring of multiples characteristic frequencies of broken bars fault. The search for the presence or absence of certain spectral components of the line current makes it possible to distinguish between the broken bars fault and the load torque variation. The presented experimental results in this paper show the interest and the effectiveness of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: On Free-Space Optical Communication as a Backhauls Applications for 5G
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this area where the 5G started to be commercialize in the global world. Scientists work on 6G and want to find a new way to transmit data. Today one of the main purposes is to optimize and accelerate data transmission. Why use free-space optical transmission? The answers find their roots, in our way of consuming. Indeed, today there is an increase of using data and the internet. Redes are saturated, so free space optical transmission will appear as the answer if these issues. The number of connected user equipment’s are expected to be more than 50 billion by the end of 2023.

articleTitle: Modeling for the Design of Synchronous Reluctance Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The SynRM stands for synchronous reluctance machine. The machine rotor has no windings, no conducting bar and no permanent magnet. Its rotor loss is negligibly small so that it has higher efficiency than the traditional induction motor and satisfies the high standard on efficiency such as IE3, IE4 or IE5. In addition, it has lower cost than the permanent magnet motor. Therefore, it is increasingly used in electrical vehicles. The article presents a method to design a synchronous reluctance motor. The sizing equation is presented and discussed. The motor is initially designed using analytical equations then the design is refined by using time-stepping transient finite element method (FEM) including rotor motion. The concept to make automatically transient FEM is given out. The influence of design parameters on torque ripple is investigated.

articleTitle: Investigation Dynamic Characteristics of Electric Vehicle Participating in the Competition Shell Eco-Marathon
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In this paper, the dynamic characteristics of an electric vehicle participating in the Shell Eco-marathon race are investigated. The research was conducted with a GPS data logger system. Data were obtained on the braking deceleration of the electric vehicle total stopping distance at different speeds. The acceleration time of the electric vehicle at different speeds is determined. The obtained results are directly related to the safety of both the pilot and the other participants in the competition. This is also one of the goals of the competition itself.

articleTitle: A Survey of Data Quality in Digital Processing of Acoustic Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: With development over time the features and quality of modern PC sound cards are increasing. New sound cards offer 24-bit quantization and higher sampling frequencies, which in some cases go up to 196 kHz. Every new sound card is compatible with professional DAW software which finds application for creating music, editing signals and it can be used as a measuring device. In music noise is one of the biggest problems which affects the dynamic range of a sound card, especially those in computer cases. It’s shown that sound cards that are connected via a USB port rather than directly in the slot in a PC are slightly less affected by noise. The present scientific article is analysing and comparing two sound cards which are measured by the professional DAW software Studio One.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Electrical Parameters of the Human Body in the Analysis of Severe Electrical Injuries
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Electrical injuries resulting to lethal outcome, temporary or permanent disabilities and absence from work are a severe problem. According to the recent legislation such accidents are a subject of an obligatory expert investigation, conducted by competent specialists who analyze the situation, find the causes for the accident, the responsible people and provide evidence in a written form for the needs of the Investigation and the Prosecution.Despite the great diversity of consequences for a person caused by electrocution, the fact is that the current flowing through human’s body is dependent on a limited number of parameters and factors that have to be taken into consideration. With a great importance between them are human body’s electrical parameters, such as skin capacitance, skin resistance and resistance of internal organs, which can vary by values in dependence on age, gender, psycho-physical condition, health status etc.The paper inhere proposes a practical approach for determination of Human body’s equivalent circuit parameters by means of experimental measurements, deduction of mathematical expressions and their approbation in calculations.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Qualitative Dependence between the Character of Wear and the Mutual Location of Wearing Supports
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The most common failures and reasons for subsequent repair of large-scale sliding bearings are: deviation from the initial geometric shape of the friction surfaces, scratches and cuts occurring on the friction surfaces, tolerances and defects as a result of diameter and length discrepancies – sagging, bending, divergence, axles intersection and boundary wear. Sliding bearings and the bearing journals below them are flaw detected by measuring the bearing surface microgeometry, followed by a comparison with the standard tolerances and defects at various diameters and lengths, and inspection of the defects. The present study analyses different friction surfaces of large-scale sliding bearings and the results show a correlation between the type of wearing, the relative position of the bearing supports and the deviations from the correct geometric shape of the friction surfaces. A qualitative correlation between the type of wearing and the relative position of the two bearing supports has been investigated and established. Bearing journal wear is out of the scope of the present study.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Characteristics of EGLA on 110 kV Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The subject of this paper is application of surge arresters with external spark gap for protection of double circuit transmission power lines. The authors focused on energy absorption characteristics of surge arrester during the direct lightning strike to the tower top in the conditions of high soil resistivity. In this case back flashover phenomena become the most dangerous. The 110 kV double circuit line was modelled using EMTP. Surge arresters were installed at each phase conductor of one circuit. This configuration can only reduce the probability of single outages of the unprotected circuit. The dissipated energy of surge arresters significantly reduces during insulation flashovers of the unprotected circuit. The energy absorption without insulation flashes is 1.5⁓6 times larger than that with them. The calculated integral distributions of surge arresters discharge energy were compared with distributions from organization standard of FGC UES (Federal Grid Company of Unified Energy System). It can be concluded that in this standard the distributions are presented without taking into account the influence of line insulation flashovers.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Water Resource in a Hydrographic Basin with Complex Hydropower Development
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The energy produced in hydropower plants is dependent on both the operation management and a factor that can be less controlled by humans, namely the variation of rivers flows. The aim of the paper is to analyze the evolution of chronological recorded flows over a period of 57 years, from 1951 to 2007 and to observe the trend of these time series data. During the spring-summer period, river flows are considerable, so they can generally ensure energy generation. The analysis done in this paper demonstrates that in the series of monthly flows averaged over 6 months (September-February) there is an increasing trend of river flows, so in winter months.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Solution for Pump System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Paper concerns the electrical part of a pumping station for a small village. Modernization of the drinking water supply system through the use of new electric driving equipment is proposed. After computer mathematical modeling, an assessment of the arising electrical losses in the driving electric motors, as well as the individual components of energy losses under different conditions has been done. Electric motors in this case are a major component and the level of energy efficiency ultimately depends on their dynamic behavior. Some of the study results have been presented in tabular and graphical form. Relevant conclusions of a recommendatory nature have been done.

articleTitle: Investigating the Wavelength and Polarization of Electromagnetic Wave using Raspberry Pi Zero W
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Two measurements concerning electromagnetic waves are presented. First measurement is devoted to the wavelength, the second one is to the polarization. In both cases the Raspberry Pi Zero W and Wi-Fi router at 2.4 GHz are used. In the first measurement two metal plates are arranged in a way to create standing wave to wavelength investigation. In the second measurement the plane of wires is arranged in a way to pass only particular polarization. Again, the Raspberry Pi Zero W is employed to investigate the polarization of electromagnetic wave. The suitability of measurements in the base laboratory course is approved.

articleTitle: RNG Entropy Enrichment to Improve Cybersecurity in IoT and Cloud Services
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Compliance with cybersecurity demands is a necessity for the harmlessness and certainty of IoT devices and applications, infrastructures, and the protection of confidential data. The quality of cryptographic security in cloud services is key to IoT security. A variety of vital IoT applications rely on random numbers. The random number generators (RNG) used in many IoT devices have a serious fundamental weakness that challenges the security of the encryption keys they generate for communications. In this regard, the topics of cryptography and sufficiently robust random number creation, which are the basis of any encryption system, are of particular interest. This study seeks to answer a question which has been worrying many researchers long ago, namely how predictable and vulnerable an RNG is in a computer system that provides IoT cloud services. The quality of an array of random numbers was investigated by simulations. The consideration of the presented results concludes that due to the inefficiency in the random numbers and the established breaking of cryptographic defense, the IoT-based cloud service can happen to be a victim of various types of hacker attacks. The ways to improve the quality of the generator, both software and hardware, are indicated.

articleTitle: Variable Input Transimpedance Amplifier for Perovskite and Thin-film Photovoltaics Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper presents a high-gain variable input transimpedance amplifier (TIA) for perovskite and thin-film photovoltaic sensing applications. The TIA serves as the analog front end (AFE) in the sensing system. The proposed TIA circuit employs two signal amplification stages. A cascode current mirror with a diode-connected NMOS device as an active load constitutes the first stage. The second stage is a modified two-stage op-amp circuit with its differential input devices operating in the triode region. This helps to mitigate power dissipation in the circuit. The TIA exhibits the ability to sense a wide range of input current (10 nA-20 mA) and amplifies and converts the current to a voltage of 1.12 V-1.27 V. For the specified sensing range, the TIA yields a transimpedance gain of 40 dBΩ-125 dBΩ, while consuming a peak power of 1.04 mW at a 1.8 V supply. The output current of perovskite and thin-film photovoltaics can be conveniently sensed by the proposed TIA, while the further stages of the sensing system are driven by the TIA output. The circuit is implemented in UMC180 nm technology within the Cadence Virtuoso environment.

articleTitle: Predictivity of Category Based Human Navigation and the Effect of Navigation Path Length on the Prediction Accuracy in Knowledge Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In web sites containing large amount of information, systems which help visitors access the contents they are interested in, significantly increase the usability of the sites. Knowing the category of the content that the user wants to access is important to offer more qualified suggestions and advertisements to the user. On the other hand, as the user continues to navigate in the site, more navigation data is obtained from him, which may potentially be used for better predictions.In this study, the predictability of users' category-based navigation and the effect of the length of the navigation path on the prediction accuracy in knowledge networks is investigated using LSTM classifiers.

articleTitle: Thermal Neutron Radiography Facility Based on 13 MeV Proton Linac on Be Target
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Based on the neutron source of the CNS DARIA project the article a neutron radiography unit was simulated via the MCNPX 2.4.0 radiation transport code which uses the Monte Carl code. Both the design and the simulation have been simulated in order to maximize all the important with thermal-neutron radiography factors. The presented facility has been examined for a broad range of these parameters namely for the L/D ratio, the thermal neutron flux and the thermal neutron content in two cases with and without fast neutron filter. With intention to evaluate the results of the unit made a comparison with other similar facilities which are published in this scientific area. The comparison reveals that facility is capable to supply an excellent possibility for the installation of a thermal-neutron radiography unit.

articleTitle: Traffic Load Prediction in Markov Chains using Artificial Intelligence Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper suggests an approach based on artificial intelligence for the evaluation and synthesis of models for predictive analysis of the complex amount of users in the queue and serviced system users in modelling Markov chain M/M/25/k in procedural selection of controllable factors. Regression modelling procedures have been carried out by Generalized Regression Neural Networks (GRNNs) and Cascaded-Forward Neural Networks (CFNNs). The results of study about the investigated neural models are presented according to an assessment of the Mean-Squared Error criterion at fixed variation ranges of the spread indicator for GRNNs and the hidden neurons in CFNNs selection procedures. The studies carried out cover the cases of specified sets of teletraffic predictors combinations applied - average request rate, service time and queue capacity. Sufficient minimization levels of MSE of the order of 10<sup>-4</sup>, 10<sup>-5</sup> are achieved, determining the positive qualities of synthesized predictive neural models.

articleTitle: Digital Media as an Essence of a Human and a Cyberspace Extension
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The paper reviews modern society and its subordination to informational and communication technology and media. It is said that man becomes trapped within the media world and less and less realizes his essence as a human being. The economic effects of media have greatly exceeded expectations. The possibilities of using the media as a source of income are incredible today. The paper mentions McLuhan's theory of extensions as man's second hands. The influence of extensions on a person is enormous. In times of information saturation, the media have a special responsibility for what they publish. At the center of everything is man and his subordination to the media as extensions and the question of realizing the essence of man in today's time.

articleTitle: EM Interference at the Clinic – A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This paper describes a case of electromagnetic interference at the intensive department of the cardiologic clinic of the University of Pécs where electromagnetic disturbances radiated by a loose electric contact of a lamp caused harmful interferences with the cardiac monitors. As a result of this disturbance the monitors suffered reversible interferences making them temporarily useless. Cause of this radiated disturbance emission was the joint impact of a loose contact and the vibrating ballast in a fluorescent lamp. Furthermore the art of the protection against electric shock applied in sick-wards contributed to the development of the interferences. Localization of the disturbance source has been performed with the help of a network and a spectrum analyzer. In a laboratory of the department the disturbance emission has been registered with the same lamp in a GTEM cell as well. To prevent this kind of interferences a regular check of the contacts in the electrical installation has to be performed and it is advisable to use lamps with electronic ballasts.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Network Control Model Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Traditionally, distribution network automation systems have a centralized architecture in which data from various field devices, such as measuring devices and remote termination devices, are centrally managed by a dispatch and data collection system. Unlike traditional methods, blockchain technology facilitates the transfer of digital assets between peer-to-peer nodes without any intermediaries. This article presents a decentralized system model built on the Cisco Packet Tracer program and a table with the time taken to exchange data between the virtual power plant, which can be used to calculate a profitable purchase or sale of energy.

articleTitle: A Method for Automatic Color Correction of Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The article presents a method for color correction of images. A Colorchecker Passport - X-rite reference card was used to report the reference values of each color. After measuring the colors from a captured image on the reference card, average deviations from each color were calculated. The color correction method involves adding the calculated deviations to the measured values. Image quality and brightness have been shown to improve after applying color correction.

articleTitle: Biometric Venous Verification System for Smartphone
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In recent years, biometric technologies continue to be actively integrated into various fields around the world and directly in human life. They have become an integral component of the global information technology market and are a convenient tool for solving a wide range of tasks. Biometric technologies have found their application and are widely used in banks, schools, libraries, institutes, the financial sector, corporate and government agencies, as well as in consumer electronics such as smartphones and tablets. They also help big businesses automate access control and control processes, being indispensable helpers in addition to traditional security methods. Two approaches to the location of the near-infrared camera module and the LED indicator - functional components of the designed biometric vein scanning system - are proposed. The process of recognizing and isolating features is based on the ORB algorithm. The software is implemented using the OpenCV open-source library, which contains functions and classes for image processing by computer vision algorithms. Such a system, built into the smartphone and working in real time, can be used, for example, to make online payments, confirm important actions and, above all, unlock the screen without touching the device itself.

articleTitle: An Approach for Improving the Network Resilience Based on Optimal Structural Reservation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Nowadays, increasing the resilience of information and telecommunication networks in the face of many different threats and impacts is one of the most important areas of network security. The task of optimal structural reservation of the telecommunication network is formulated as a search for a reservation option, which ensures maximum resilience of the network when meeting the cost constraints of the reservation network elements. The paper describes the problem of optimal structural reservation for improving the network resilience. Possible solutions of this problem are considered. It is shown that the preferred method to solve the problem is the method of Lagrange multipliers. Results of experimental evaluation of proposed method are presented.

articleTitle: Smart Contracts based on Hyperledger Fabric Blockchain for the Purpose of Higher Education Subsidizing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: During their studies, many students drop out of one specialty, then apply and enroll in another. The state subsidized several semesters of their studies, then again subsidized the student's studies in another specialty. A number of students start but do not complete their studies, but this has been subsidized by the state as well. No research has been focused on the state's losses from subsidizing education in these cases. This paper proposes a model where any citizen can receive a subsidy for his studies, but only for up to 10 semesters. After that, he has to pay the full cost of his education. Under this model, students are motivated to complete their studies within the subsidized semesters, and the state does not suffer losses from refinancing the same student whose study period exceeds these semesters. The model is based on a smart contract on Hyperledger Fabric platform.

articleTitle: Local Polynomial Models for Real-Time Tracking of Humidity Sensor Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Sensor signal tracking has great practical importance for solving a number of problems such as data fusion and sensor integration in multi-sensor systems (MSS), robotics, fault detection (FD), and diagnosis, etc. The Kalman filter is a widely used algorithm that can be applied in these cases if an appropriate model of the signal is available. The present study shows that under a step change in humidity, the filter can estimate the signal from a humidity sensor by means of a second-order local polynomial model. This gives a reason to expect similar behavior not only for sudden but also for all other changes. The proposed online signal tracking solution is simple to implement and can be used not only for humidity sensors, but also for sensors that measure quantities such as temperature, pressure, level, etc.

articleTitle: NIS Test for Selecting the Order of Local Polynomial Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: This work presents an approach that uses normalized innovations squared (NIS) test to determine the order of a local polynomial trend model of a humidity sensor signal. Compared to the classical Akaike information criterion which balances model fit and model complexity NIS test allows to determine the lowest order of the model at which a consistent Bayesian estimation is possible. This approach is useful when signal processing algorithms, such as those for data fusion in multi-sensor systems, contain a Kalman filter, because a successful NIS test is a prerequisite for normal filter operation. The results of the study show that the response of the SHT31-DIS sensor under a step change in humidity is adequately described by a second-order local polynomial model, and this implies a consistent estimation for other input variations.

articleTitle: Dynamic Stability for UAV Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Modern Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are being widely used for civil as well as military missions such as package delivery, surveillance and photography. For all of these missions the UAVs are instructed to track a fixed or moving point or target. For that purposes many tracking control algorithm are developed. Those method should converge toward the target in the quickest possible time, they should be computationally efficient in order to reduce the computational burden on the UAV main processor and smooth in order to reduce the mechanical stress on the drone. The control problem is more pronounced in case it is applied for fixed wing drones. This paper propose a control tracking algorithm for HALE (High Altitude Long Endurance) drones. The method is nearly optimal, smooth and uses a computationally efficient algorithm. In order to evaluate the new control law, simulation results are presented and compared with older method. Finally, conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: The Effect of External Forces on the Load Sharing of a Full Planet Engagement Planetary Gear Train
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The aim of the study is to experimentally investigate the effects of external forces on the load sharing characteristics of the full planet engagement gear train. This type of planetary gear trains has a high power density but due to the complexity of the planets’ arrangement and the resulting specific assembly and adjacent conditions they are not widely used and there is very little known about the load distribution between the planets, especially in case of additional external loads applied to the gear train. To explore that influence a special test rig using a closed loop power flow is designed and manufactured allowing for the application of external load parallel to the torque applied. Low speed dynamic testing is conducted with different load scenarios and positions of the carrier. All data is acquired with strain gauges and the resulting bending stresses in the pins of the planets are calculated. The load sharing factor LSF is calculated for the planets and the results are presented graphically.

articleTitle: An Approach to Design a Robot Platform with a Web-Based Virtual Reality Remote Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: A robotic challenge research is to go beyond the traditional and collaborative robotic systems focusing on flexible mobile robots with simple and faster programming, flexible peripherals and grippers and full manual access for easy maintenance meeting the demands for fast layout change and reliable maintenance. Such designed robotic systems with up-todate achievements in intelligent navigation and cognitive sensing could ensure intelligent actions in unforeseen situations where is required human-machine interaction. The main goal of the paper is to present a concept of system architecture of near-autonomous robots with human remote-control takeover possibility is the main challenge of the paper where to allow the human to control a large number of service robots and the price is reasonable are main targets.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Model based Approach to Estimate the Controlling Parameters in SMART Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The article reviews the core elements of the mathematical description of the Heuristic model for SMART management in the medium-sized industrial enterprises. Some suitable specific restrictive conditions, as well as criteria for solving the task for achieving smart management on the basis of a heuristic toolset and controlling parameters have been generated and integrated in the model on the basis of the specific characteristics of a medium-sized industrial enterprise. The mathematical expression of the model is reduced to optimization, which facilitates the achievement of efficient smart management in a medium-sized industrial entity.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Sensor Data Storing Systems for Educational Purposes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Modern life is increasingly based on Internet of Things (IoT) technologies. These technologies contribute to the concept of connected life, facilitate end users’ daily lives and are the subject of research and education. All IoT technologies allow tracking of the reported information from the connected objects. There are a number of technologies used for IoT , such as ZigBee, due to its wide possibilities for applications in sensor networks, and LoRa for its wide range. However, in many cases it is not enough, to display this information visually, a centralised local or cloud database must be used to store history, analyse data and display statistics. As a result, it is possible to prepare forecasts and statistics regarding future events.This paper presents the implementation of a real system for receiving, storing and analysing the information from the nodes in sensor ZigBee and LoRa networks for educational purposes. The reading of information from the end nodes and its presentation to the user is done through the MQTT protocol and Mosquitto broker. The storage of the received information is performed on a MongoDB database server. The transfer of the information flow from the Mosquitto broker to the MongoDB database is carried out using Python scripts. The analysis of the information stored in the database is done with the help of a created web interface.

articleTitle: Modelling of a Test-rig for the River Energy Utilization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Hydraulic power is that which uses the kinetic energy (which is generated by movement) and the potential (the stored energy given the position of the object) from currents or waterfalls or tides.Hydropower is usually generated by river flows, which in turn come from rain and thaw.The work presents modeling of a test-rig with hydrokinetic turbines. The hydrokinetic turbine or running water turbine has emerged as a sustainable alternative for power generation in rivers, in low slope stretches, from the kinetic energy of its currents or rapids. It is made some preliminary experiments at an angle of attack of 25<sup>0</sup> and a turbine with diameter of 50 mm and it is measure a velocity of river flow.

articleTitle: The Challenges and Opportunities in Adopting AI, IoT and Blockchain Technology in E-Government: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Over the past decades, governments around the world are implementing a variety of digital solutions in order to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and transparency of public services. By using modern information and communication technologies (ICT), citizens are provided with an easier, faster, and more secure way of accessing different types of data. Previous studies on e-government have given important insights into the differences between traditional government systems and digital, e-government. The research was conducted by the systematic literature review guidelines by Kitchenham for papers published between 2016 and 2021 and aims to identify main technologies that are adequate to be used in the context of e-government, by presenting key challenges, as well as opportunities and possible risks of adopting such solutions in public sector services. The results obtained suggest that pairing governance with modern information systems, such as artificial intelligence (AI), internet of things (IoT) and blockchain technology, if used properly, can contribute to achieving a higher level of quality of public services and encouragement of citizens' trust and further political activity. Therefore, the present study concluded that there is a significant dependency between a successful e-government implementation and the country's established legal foundations, available technical infrastructures, perceived public trust, as well as social and economical conditions.

articleTitle: Cloud-Based Big Data Approach for Managing Multi-Types Data of Cultural Heritage
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: With the growth of digitisation and data gathering, digital information processing and archiving for cultural heritage keeps expanding. This research presents a new approach based on cloud computing for managing the multi types of data related to the cultural heritage of Nineveh’s areas. It involves using different virtualisation techniques in the cloud, such as virtual machines and Docker containers. First, data have been collected from a group of multiple miscellaneous repositories (e.g. social media networks, encyclopedias, google maps). It was then cleaned and structured before storage was applied. The results showed the collection of diverse and valuable data about cultural heritage efficiently to implement various queries based on the keywords representing the heritage to obtain all the related data. Our new approach provides a formative reference to preserving techniques for sustainable protection and development of cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control in Multi-Source Power Generation Systems using Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: One of the main problems of power generation systems (either isolated or interconnected) is related to the frequency regulation and the continuous effort to keep the frequency as stable as possible with respect to various load fluctuations. The subject of this paper is the optimization of load-frequency controllers of single-area multi-source power generating systems. Specifically, a specific model which emerge from the international literature is presented to be studied. The main goal is to tune the controller of each generating source i.e. find their optimal gains through bio-inspired optimization algorithms. The algorithms which were applied are the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm-used as a benchmark- and the Harris Hawk Optimization (HHO) algorithm, as the proposed one. The integral-in-time absolute error (ITAE) performance index is the corresponding objective function. The systems are being studied in the environment of Matlab/ Simulink and the derivation of the (sub)-optimal gains of the controllers result from the proper use of a custom written Matlab script which implements the optimization procedure. The results obtained show that the HHO performs better than those obtained through PSO, particularly in the case where the nonlinearity of the system under consideration increases.

articleTitle: Exoskeleton for the Ankle Joint Design and Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The ankle joint is one of the most commonly broken joints in the human body. It is usually prone to sprains or fractures and requires exercise support to restore mobility. While physiotherapists typically conduct individual rehabilitation with diierent patients, numerous efficacious robotic rehabilitation solutions have been proposed in recent years. However, their conception is often heavy and forces the patient to sit or stand in a static position. In this article, a lightweight hand-held device to facilitate ankle movement is offered for ankle movement exercises in rehabilitation and training. The portable device is based on the extensive motion of the human ankle supplied in rehabilitation. The amplitude of motion of the ankle joint is investigated as a characteristic of a specific movement using a numerical model.

articleTitle: Increasing the Efficiency of Irrigation Systems in the Republic of Bulgaria Through New Electrical Systems and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The quality of services determines the standard of living of people, the well-being of companies, and the formation of GDP. Such is the household and communal services, but the latter are fundamental for the existence of the household. In this aspect, maintaining the quality of all systems of the utility sector is very important. It appears that significant problems exist in the electricity supply, water supply, and communications. In water supply, they are heterogeneous given the presence of leaks, seasonality of service use, drought, reduced harvest, and others. From this point of view, the aim of the article is to analyze the origin of the problems in the water supply system. The institutions responsible for the various types of water supply systems are presented. Based on this analysis, means to increase the quality of services are proposed. A blockchain-based accident monitoring scheme has been synthesized between the responsible authorities.

articleTitle: Potential of Big Data Analytics for Managing Value Creation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The growing interest in Big Data (BD) and Big Data Analytics (BDA) by the business in recent years requires looking for models to reveal their economic potential and their ability to generate value. The article aims to identify the main factors that affect the implementation of BD and BDA in business organizations and to present and compare the models for creating value from them. The main method of research is the systematic review of the scientific literature on the subject. By applying a structural approach and critical analysis of publications on the topic, the most important factors affecting the generation of value with BDA are summarized, a comparison between models for generating value is made and is provided a model, consisting of the following 7 main steps: Data generation, Data collection, Data processing, Data storage, Data analysis, Data visualization, and Data presentation. As a result of the study, we concluded that organizations which implement BD and BDA in their activities must be familiar with the factors affecting this process, as well as models for generating value with their intrinsic stages and characteristics. Their in-depth analysis is an important step towards the adoption of BD technology and the BDA model, corresponding to the specifics of business activities and the scale of the organization. This matter may be the subject of further research.

articleTitle: Performing Strategic Spectrum Sensing Study for the Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In order to address the spectrum scarcity issues that affect today's wireless services, the concept of cognitive radio has been proposed. A licensed spectrum is made available to smart and adaptable secondary users through this framework. Because of cognitive radio technology, these unlicensed secondary users can take advantage of any spectrum utilization opportunity by dynamically adjusting their broadcast characteristics. In this study, we explore the defining aspects and primary capabilities of cognitive radio focused technology. As well as Spectrum sensing has been considered a key enabling technology for cognitive radio based wireless networks of the future. In this paper, we evaluate and contrast a variety of technologies in terms of their sensing sensitivity, the complexity of implementation, and computational demands. Several problems with spectrum sensing have been studied, and several opinions have been presented.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Plastic Waste Detection: State-of-the-art, Challenges, and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: Machine learning has advanced rapidly in recent technologies of artificial intelligence. The abundant and cheap computation in machine learning has created more knowledge and reliability of this method. Therefore, more researchers have relied on machine learning to solve plastic waste pollution, which contributes to global greenhouse gas emissions. Datasets are fundamental requirements to build the foundation of the plastic waste detection system. This paper provides an overview of several state-of-the-art deep learning models, focusing on the dataset used for waste classification and identification. The performance of each deep learning model in classification accuracy is also discussed. The challenges of implementing deep learning in plastic waste detection are identified; (i) Data deficiency for training, (ii) Quality of the existing plastic waste dataset, and (iii) Color spaces. Lastly, the proposed solution to each challenge is presented.

articleTitle: AP13068541 Development of an Experimental Energy Complex Based on an Upgraded Boiler Plant Using Biofuels
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The article discusses the use of biogas in the industrial and agricultural sectors of the economy of the Republic of Kazakhstan, to generate heat. Energy production from biomass or animal husbandry waste, in the new economic realities allows to achieve an effective and sustainable reduction of environmental loads.The aim of the paper is to develop an experimental energy complex for the production of thermal energy from biomass or animal waste, consisting of a biofuel production site, a biogas synthesis plant, a thermal generator - a new type of hot water boiler.

articleTitle: Conceptual Foundations of Engineering Restructuring of Manufacturing System in a Cyber-Physical Manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: The issue of restructuring the real production system into a cyber-physical production system has not been addressed in scientific developments and research. For this reason, this article presents the author's perspective on defining the conceptual foundations of this restructuring. The study, research and analysis of scientific publications and points of view on the subject under consideration shows that in the scientific doctrine there is no formed concept of the restructuring of the production system in a cyber-physical production system, of the types of restructuring, of the methods of its implementation, of its possible risks and benefits to the manufacturing business organization. There are extremely few developments devoted to cyber-physical production systems, and there is a complete absence of those providing scientific expertise on the processes of restructuring real, physical production systems into cyber-physical production systems. In the present article, the definition of the specific changes in the structure of actual production systems during their restructuring into cyber-physical production systems can be indicated as a scientific result.

articleTitle: HisDataTJ: ImageJ Plugin for Global Thresholding with Application in Bread Porosity Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: It is developed a plugin for ImageJ that performs global thresholding through four innovative thresholding algorithms, which are designed last five years. These algorithms are HisMedian, SubMedian-1, SubMedian-2, and HisAnalysis. The algorithm SubMedian-2 uses secondary median value in the sub-histogram as a threshold and it is applied for white bread porosity evaluation. The algorithm HisAnalysis uses as a threshold a color with maximal frequency in image histogram and it is applied for brown bread porosity evaluation. It is implemented also an algorithm (MedHASM-2) that combines methods for threshold finding which are used by HisAnalysis and SubMedian-2 algorithms. This paper presents a research of possibilities for application of global thresholding algorithms in wheat bread type "Dobrudzha" porosity evaluation. Four samples of different brands of wheat bread are used for experiments. The porosity of tested samples is measured through physicochemical analysis. The results are compared with results of image processing through correlation analysis. The highest correlation coefficients are calculated for results of thresholding with algorithms HisAnalysis and MedHASM-2. Based on the results of statistical data processing it is proposed an equation for calculation of the bread porosity using the ratio of white pixels to all in binary images. The average error for bread porosity calculated with the proposed equation is about 1% using the algorithm MedHASM-2 and about 3% using the algorithm HisAnalysis.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Free-Space Optical Transmission Systems and Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Communications, Information, Electronic and Energy Systems (CIEES)
abstract: In recent years have seen several significant advances in technology, particularly in the field of wireless communication, and demand has been growing at an exponential rate.
